[from.GetName]恒星系内我们的灵能光环正在与来自附近[fromfrom.GetName]恒星系的敌对光环进行激烈斗争。我们的灵能[GetResearchers]曾对这种行为进行过建模，但这是我们第一次获得这种现象的一手资料。

理论上来说，越强的光环——就是说投射的强度越大——将会逐渐驱散敌对力量。如果这种斗争导致一方完败，占主导地位的光环可能就会流入空出来的恒星系。

这真是字面意义上的“灵魂的碰撞”。

texts.en:
Our Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system is struggling against an opposing Aura originating from the nearby [fromfrom.GetName] system. Our psionic [GetResearchers] have previously modeled such behavior, though this is the first time we have experienced the phenomenon firsthand.

According to theory, the more potent Aura - that which is projected with a greater intensity - will gradually diminish the opposing force. Should this struggle lead to absolute decay, the prevailing Aura may flow into the vacant system.

It is a true battle of the minds.

# 灵能光环冲突 / Psionic Aura Clashing

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:4029-4040`; `common/scripted_effects/psionic_auras_scripted_effects.txt:118-136 (trigger_aura_clashing_event)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

本国灵能光环第一次与另一个光环相互冲突时（光环每月/开始时的冲突检查调用 trigger_aura_clashing_event），光环拥有者收到此事件和对应教程提示；只发生一次（aura_clashing_event_triggered）。

The first time our psionic aura clashes with another aura (the clash checks on aura start/monthly call trigger_aura_clashing_event), the aura owner gets this event plus a tutorial hint; once only (aura_clashing_event_triggered).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

研究者说明理论预测：更强的光环将压倒较弱的一方。单一确认选项。

Researchers explain the theory that the more potent aura will overwhelm the weaker one. One acknowledgement option.
